### 1st-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 1st-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### Censor Order {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/censor-order" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Censor Order</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p><a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">Censors</a> are the will of their god made physically manifest, and you act as your god&#39;s agent in the world. As you shoulder that responsibility, you choose a <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> from the following options, each of which grants you a skill. (<em>Quick Build:</em> Paragon.)</p>
<ul><li><b>Exorcist:</b> You specialize in hunting your order&#39;s hidden enemies, knowing that an open mind is an unguarded fortress. You have the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/read-person/">Read Person</a> skill.</li><li><b>Oracle:</b> Corruption has deep tendrils that can be missed, leading you to specialize in uncovering clandestine threats to your order. You have the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/lore/magic/">Magic</a> skill.</li><li><b>Paragon:</b> Without a strong example and a firm hand, the weak will be corrupted. You specialize in setting an example for your order. You have the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/lead/">Lead</a> skill.</li></ul>
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> is your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/subclass/">subclass</a>, and your choice of order determines many of the features you&#39;ll gain as you gain new levels.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Deity and Domains {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/deity-and-domains" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Deity and Domains</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Choose a god or <a href="../../../Browse/rule/world/saint/">saint</a> who your character reveres from Chapter 14: <a href="../gods-and-religion/">Gods and Religion</a>, or ask your Director about the deities in your campaign world. With the Director&#39;s permission, you can also create your own deity and choose four domains to be part of their portfolio.</p>
<p>After choosing your deity, pick one domain from their portfolio. Your choice of domain determines many of the features you&#39;ll gain from this class. (<em>Quick Build:</em> <a href="../../../Browse/religion/god/cavall/">Cavall</a> as deity and War as domain.)</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Wrath {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/wrath" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait" data-sub="2">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Wrath</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>The power you serve grants you a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource/">Heroic Resource</a> called wrath, fueling your abilities as you <a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">censor</a> those your church deems to be heretics.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Wrath in Combat</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>At the start of a combat encounter or some other stressful situation tracked in <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round/">combat rounds</a> (as determined by the Director), you gain wrath equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a>. At the start of each of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a> during combat, you gain 2 wrath.</p>
<p>Additionally, the first time each <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round/">combat round</a> that a creature judged by you (see <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> below) deals damage to you, you gain 1 wrath. The first time each <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/combat-round/">combat round</a> that you deal damage to a creature judged by you, you gain 1 wrath.</p>
<p>You lose any remaining wrath at the end of the encounter.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Wrath Outside of Combat</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Though you can&#39;t gain wrath outside of combat, you can use your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic abilities</a> and effects that cost wrath without spending it. Whenever you use an ability or effect outside of combat that costs wrath, you can&#39;t use that same ability or effect outside of combat again until you earn 1 or more <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a> or finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
<p>When you use an ability outside of combat that lets you spend unlimited wrath on its effect, you can use it as if you had spent an amount of wrath equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a>. (Such abilities aren&#39;t part of the core rules for the <a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">censor</a>, but they might appear in future products.)</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Judgment {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/judgment" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest" data-action="trait" data-sub="2">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Judgment</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You pick out the enemies most worthy of your wrath and place a divine <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">judgment</a> upon them, censoring them with the power of your god. You have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver" data-conditions="taunted">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Judgment</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You utter a prayer that outlines your foe in holy energy.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One enemy</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target is judged by you until the end of the encounter, you use this ability again, you willingly end this effect (no action required), or another <a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">censor</a> judges the target.</p><p>Whenever a creature judged by you uses a main action and is within your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect/">line of effect</a>, you can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to deal holy damage equal to twice your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score to them.</p><p>When a creature judged by you is reduced to 0 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a>, you can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to use this ability against a new target.</p><p>Additionally, you can spend 1 wrath to take one of the following free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered actions</a>:</p><ul><li>When an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> creature judged by you starts to <a href="../../../Browse/movement/shifting/">shift</a>, you make a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">melee</a> <a href="../../../Browse/feature/common/main-actions/free-strike/">free strike</a> against them and their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a> becomes 0 until the end of the current <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>, preventing them from <a href="../../../Browse/movement/shifting/">shifting</a>.</li><li>When a creature judged by you within 10 squares makes a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll/">power roll</a>, you cause them to take a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bane/">bane</a> on the roll.</li><li>When a creature judged by you within 10 squares uses an ability with a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/potency/">potency</a> that targets only one creature, the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/potency/">potency</a> is reduced by 1 for that creature.</li><li>If you damage a creature judged by you with a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">melee</a> ability, the creature is <a href="../../../Browse/condition/taunted/">taunted</a> by you until the end of their next <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>.</li></ul><p>You can choose only one free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> option at a time, even if multiple options are triggered by the same effect.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Judgment Order Benefit</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>The first time on a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a> that you use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> ability to judge a creature, you gain the following benefit based on your order:</p>
<ul><li><b>Exorcist:</b> You can <a href="../../../Browse/movement/teleport/">teleport</a> up to a number of squares equal to twice your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. This movement must take you closer to the judged creature. You do not need <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect/">line of effect</a> to your destination.</li><li><b>Oracle:</b> You can deal holy damage equal to twice your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score to the judged creature.</li><li><b>Paragon:</b> You can vertical <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">pull</a> the judged creature up to a number of squares equal to twice your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score.</li></ul>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Kit {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/kit" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Kit</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You can use and gain the benefits of a kit. See Chapter 6: <a href="../kits/">Kits</a> for more information. (<em>Quick Build:</em> <a href="../../../Browse/kit/warrior-priest/">Warrior Priest</a>.)</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### My Life for Yours {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/my-life-for-yours" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest" data-action="trait" data-sub="1" data-grant="the My Life for Yours triggered action">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">My Life for Yours</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You channel your will to mend your wounds or the wounds of your allies. You have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="triggered" data-conditions="prone">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">)</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">My Life for Yours</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Triggered Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You channel some of your vitality into more resilience for you or an ally.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self or one ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Trigger</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target starts their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a> or takes damage.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>You spend a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries/">Recovery</a> and the target regains <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries/">recovery value</a>.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__enh"><span class="cost">Spend 1 Wrath</span><span class="txt">You can end one effect on the target that is ended by a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throw</a> or that ends at the end of their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>, or a <a href="../../../Browse/condition/prone/">prone</a> target can stand up.</span></div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### 1st-Level Domain Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/1st-level-domain-feature" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait" data-sub="13">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">1st-Level Domain Feature</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You gain a domain feature from your domain, as shown on the 1st-Level <a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">Censor</a> Domain Features table. Additionally, you gain a skill from your domain, chosen from the skill group indicated on the table.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">1st-Level Censor Domain Features Table</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<table><thead><tr><th>Domain</th><th>Feature</th><th>Skill Group</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Creation</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/hands-of-the-maker/">Hands of the Maker</a></td><td>Crafting</td></tr><tr><td>Death</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/grave-speech/">Grave Speech</a></td><td>Lore</td></tr><tr><td>Fate</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/oracular-visions/">Oracular Visions</a></td><td>Lore</td></tr><tr><td>Knowledge</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/blessing-of-comprehension/">Blessing of Comprehension</a></td><td>Lore</td></tr><tr><td>Life</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/revitalizing-ritual/">Revitalizing Ritual</a></td><td>Exploration</td></tr><tr><td>Love</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/blessing-of-compassion/">Blessing of Compassion</a></td><td>Interpersonal</td></tr><tr><td>Nature</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/faithful-friend/">Faithful Friend</a></td><td>Exploration</td></tr><tr><td>Protection</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/protective-circle/">Protective Circle</a></td><td>Exploration</td></tr><tr><td>Storm</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/blessing-of-fortunate-weather/">Blessing of Fortunate Weather</a></td><td>Exploration</td></tr><tr><td>Sun</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/inner-light/">Inner Light</a></td><td>Lore</td></tr><tr><td>Trickery</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/inspired-deception/">Inspired Deception</a></td><td>Intrigue</td></tr><tr><td>War</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/sanctified-weapon/">Sanctified Weapon</a></td><td>Exploration</td></tr></tbody></table>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of Compassion</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Love</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You exude a magic presence that can soothe those willing to socially engage with you. You gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on any <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> made to assist another creature with a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a>.</p>
<p>Additionally, when you are present at the start of a negotiation, one <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/npc/">NPC</a> of your choice has their patience increased by 1 (to a maximum of 5), and the first <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> made to influence them gains an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of Comprehension</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Knowledge</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You can interpret diagrams and charts even if you don&#39;t understand the language associated with them. You are considered fluent in all languages for the purpose of understanding the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/downtime/project-source/">project source</a> for any crafting or <a href="../../../Browse/rule/downtime/research-project/">research project</a> (see Chapter 12: <a href="../downtime-projects/">Downtime Projects</a>).</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of Fortunate Weather</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Storm</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Each time you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can decide the weather conditions within 100 squares. Until you finish another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, the weather conditions you establish follow you through any mundane outdoor locations. Choose one of the following types of weather, each of which grants a benefit to you and your allies:</p>
<p><b>Clear:</b> You and your allies gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> that use the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/intrigue/search/">Search</a> or <a href="../../../Browse/skill/exploration/navigate/">Navigate</a> skills.</p>
<p><b>Foggy:</b> You and your allies gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> that use the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/intrigue/hide/">Hide</a> skill.</p>
<p><b>Overcast:</b> You and your allies gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> that use the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/exploration/endurance/">Endurance</a> skill.</p>
<p><b>Precipitation:</b> When the ground is muddy or snowy, you and your allies gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> that use the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/intrigue/track/">Track</a> skill.</p>
<p>If you are in the same area as a creature using this or a similar feature who has chosen a different weather effect, the features negate each other where their areas overlap.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Faithful Friend</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Nature</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Faithful Friend</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Nature</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">An animal spirit is drawn to you, sharing their senses with you and serving you faithfully.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">Self</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>You conjure a spirit that takes the form of any animal you have seen. The incorporeal animal has <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a> 5 and can <a href="../../../Browse/movement/fly/">fly</a>, but can&#39;t physically interact with the world. While you are within 10 squares of the spirit, you automatically sense everything that type of animal would sense, in addition to sensing your own surroundings. You can dismiss the spirit at any time (no action required). If the spirit takes any damage, they are dismissed and you take 1d10 psychic damage that can&#39;t be reduced in any way.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Grave Speech</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Death</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Grave Speech</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Death</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You commune with the lingering soul of the recently dead.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a> 1</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One dead creature</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>You can speak to the target if they are a creature who has died within the last 24 hours and who can speak a language you know, even if they are just a head. The target regards you as they would have in life, and you might need to make <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> to influence them and convince them to speak with you. The trauma of <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/dying/">dying</a> can make a creature&#39;s memory of that event hazy, but the target otherwise knows all they knew in life. After 1 minute, the effect ends. You can&#39;t use this ability on the same creature twice.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Hands of the Maker</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Creation</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Hands of the Maker</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Creation</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You craft objects with the power of your mind.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">Self</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>You create a mundane object of <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/size/">size</a> 1S or smaller. You can maintain a number of objects created this way equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. You can destroy an object created this way with a thought, no matter how far you are from it (no action required).</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Inner Light</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Sun</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Each time you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can choose yourself or one ally who is also finishing a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> to gain the benefit of a divine ritual. You place a ray of <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/conduit/level-2/morning-light/">morning light</a> into the chosen character&#39;s soul, granting them a +1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throws</a> that lasts until you finish another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Inspired Deception</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Trickery</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>The gods favor your thievery with magic. Whenever you make a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> that uses a skill you have from the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/intrigue/">intrigue skill group</a>, you can use <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> on the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> instead of another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic/">characteristic</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Oracular Visions</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Fate</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your deity rewards you with hazy visions of things to come. Each time you earn 1 or more <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a>, you earn an equal number of fate points. Whenever you or a creature within 10 squares makes a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a>, you can spend 1 fate point to tap into a vision of the outcome, granting that creature an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a>. You lose any remaining fate points when you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Protective Circle</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Protection</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You can spend 10 uninterrupted minutes to create a <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/protective-circle/">protective circle</a> on the ground large enough to hold one <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/size/">size</a> 1 creature. The circle lasts for 24 hours, until you create another, or until you dismiss it (no action required). Only creatures you designate at the time of drawing the circle can enter and exit the area. While in the <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/protective-circle/">protective circle</a>, a creature can&#39;t be targeted by strikes.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Revitalizing Ritual</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Life</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Each time you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can choose yourself or one ally who is also finishing a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> to gain the benefit of a divine ritual. The chosen character gains a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries/">recovery value</a> equal to your level that lasts until you finish another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Sanctified Weapon</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · War</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>As a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> activity, you can bless a weapon. Any creature who wields the weapon gains a +1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage/">rolled damage</a> with abilities that use the weapon. This benefit lasts until you finish another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Censor Abilities {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-1/censor-abilities" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead sc-trait--section" data-action="trait" data-sub="2">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Censor Abilities</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You use a blend of martial techniques and divine magic to attack your foes and defend your allies.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Signature Ability</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability/">signature ability</a> from the following options. <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability/">Signature abilities</a> can be used at will. (<em>Quick Build:</em> <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/your-allies-cannot-save-you/">Your Allies Cannot Save You</a>!)</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Back Blasphemer!</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">Signature</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You channel power through your weapon to repel foes.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Weapon</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/cube/">cube</a> within 1</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Each enemy in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">2 holy damage; <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">push</a> 1</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">4 holy damage; <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">push</a> 2</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">6 holy damage; <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">push</a> 3</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Every Step... Death!</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">Signature</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You show your foe a glimpse of their fate after death.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">5 + P psychic damage</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">7 + P psychic damage</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">10 + P psychic damage</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Each time the target willingly moves before the end of your next <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>, they take 1 psychic damage for each square they move.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main" data-conditions="slowed">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Halt Miscreant!</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">Signature</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You infuse your weapon with holy magic that makes it difficult for your foe to get away.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Weapon</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a> 1</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature or object</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">2 + M holy damage; P &lt; WEAK, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/slowed/">slowed</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">5 + M holy damage; P &lt; AVERAGE, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/slowed/">slowed</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">7 + M holy damage; P &lt; STRONG, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/slowed/">slowed</a> (save ends)</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Your Allies Cannot Save You!</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 1</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">Signature</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">Your magic <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a> your foe&#39;s guilt into a burst of holy power.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Weapon</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a> 1</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature or object</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">3 + M holy damage</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">5 + M holy damage</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">8 + M holy damage</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Each enemy <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> to the target is <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">pushed</a> away from the target up to a number of squares equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Heroic Abilities</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You call upon a number of <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic abilities</a>, all of them bound to your wrath.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">3-Wrath Ability</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic ability</a> from the following options, each of which costs 3 wrath to use. (<em>Quick Build:</em> <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/the-gods-punish-and-defend/">The Gods Punish and Defend</a>.)</p>
</div>
</section>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
