### 2nd-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 2nd-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-2/perk" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Perk</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You gain one interpersonal, lore, or <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural/">supernatural</a> perk of your choice. See Chapter 7: <a href="../perks/">Perks</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### 2nd-Level Order Features {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-2/2nd-level-order-features" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait" data-sub="7">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">2nd-Level Order Features</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> grants you two features, as shown on the 2nd-Level Order Features table.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">2nd-Level Order Features Table</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<table><thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Features</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Exorcist</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/rule/world/saint/">Saint</a>&#39;s Vigilance, <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-2/a-sense-for-truth/">A Sense for Truth</a></td></tr><tr><td>Oracle</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-2/it-was-foretold/">It Was Foretold</a>, <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-2/judge-of-character/">Judge of Character</a></td></tr><tr><td>Paragon</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-2/lead-by-example/">Lead by Example</a>, <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-2/stalwart-icon/">Stalwart Icon</a></td></tr></tbody></table>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">It Was Foretold</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your order has trained you to understand fragments of the visions granted to you by your deity, giving you a momentary advantage in challenging situations. At the start of an encounter, you can take one main action before any other creature and before your first <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>. Additionally, whenever the Director calls for a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/montage-test/">montage test</a>, you can make one free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> before the montage begins, which counts as an earned success or failure as usual.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Judge of Character</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your focus on your fragmentary visions grants divine insight into the world and its creatures beyond your usual senses. Whenever you would make an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/intuition/">Intuition</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a>, you can make a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> instead.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Lead by Example</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your devotion to your deity allows you to take command of the battlefield, letting your allies benefit from your wisdom. While you are <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> to a creature, your allies gain the benefits of <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/flanking/">flanking</a> against that creature. Additionally, your allies gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> made to aid other creatures with their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Saint&#39;s Vigilance</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You have honed your ability to detect sin and can use it to find those who hide from justice. Any creature judged by you can&#39;t use the <a href="../../../Browse/feature/common/maneuvers/hide/">Hide</a> maneuver. Additionally, you gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> when searching for hidden creatures. If you find a hidden creature, you can use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> ability against them as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">A Sense for Truth</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You are trained in secret techniques from your order that allow you to discern the truth with <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural/">supernatural</a> precision. If a creature is of a lower level than you, you automatically know when they are lying, though you don&#39;t necessarily know the actual truth behind their lie. Additionally, you gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> made to detect lies or hidden motives.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Stalwart Icon</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You exhibit a small spark of your deity&#39;s power, causing creatures to trust or fear you, depending on what you need. You gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> made to intimidate or persuade others.</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### 2nd-Level Order Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-2/2nd-level-order-ability" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead sc-trait--section" data-action="trait" data-sub="3">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">2nd-Level Order Ability</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> grants your choice of one of two <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic abilities</a>.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">2nd-Level Exorcist Ability</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one of the following abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main" data-conditions="frightened">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">It Is Justice You Fear</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">5 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">I am but a vessel. Your own deeds weigh upon you.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">8 + M holy damage; P &lt; WEAK, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">12 + M holy damage; P &lt; AVERAGE, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">15 + M holy damage; P &lt; STRONG, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> (save ends)</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>If the target is already <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> of you or another creature and this ability would frighten them again, they instead take psychic damage equal to twice your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Revelator</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">5 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You channel holy energy to harm unbelievers and reveal those hidden from your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">judgment</a>.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/burst/">burst</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Each enemy in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Each target takes holy damage equal to twice your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. Additionally, each hidden target is automatically revealed and can&#39;t become hidden again until the start of your next <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>. You can then use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> ability against one target as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">2nd-Level Oracle Ability</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one of the following abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="triggered">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">)</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Prescient Grace</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">5 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Triggered Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">Gifted by a prescient vision, you warn an ally of an impending attack.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self or one ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Trigger</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>An enemy within 10 squares starts their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>You can spend a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries/">Recovery</a> to allow the target to regain <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries/">recovery value</a>. The target can then take their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a> immediately before the triggering enemy.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">With My Blessing</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">5 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">A word in prayer, and the gods show the way.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self or one ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to use a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability/">signature ability</a> or a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic ability</a>, and has a double <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on that ability. If a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic ability</a> is chosen, reduce its <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/heroic-resource/">Heroic Resource</a> cost by 3 (to a minimum cost of 0).</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">2nd-Level Paragon Ability</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one of the following abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of the Faithful</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">5 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">The gods reward your faith.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self and each ally in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Until the end of the encounter or until you are <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/dying/">dying</a>, each target gains 1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surge</a> at the end of each of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main" data-conditions="restrained">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Sentenced</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 2</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">5 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">The shock of your condemnation freezes your enemy in their boots.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Weapon</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a> 1</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">5 + P damage; P &lt; WEAK, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/restrained/">restrained</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">9 + P damage; P &lt; AVERAGE, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/restrained/">restrained</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">12 + P damage; P &lt; STRONG, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/restrained/">restrained</a> (save ends)</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>While the target is <a href="../../../Browse/condition/restrained/">restrained</a> this way, your abilities that impose <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">forced movement</a> can still move them.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>

### 3rd-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 3rd-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### Look On My Work and Despair {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-3/look-on-my-work-and-despair" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Look On My Work and Despair</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 3</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">judgment</a> has grown in <a href="../../../Browse/feature/conduit/level-10/divine-power/">divine power</a>, instilling fear in those you condemn. Whenever you use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> ability, you can spend 1 wrath, and if the target has P &lt; AVERAGE, they are <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> of you (save ends). Additionally, whenever a creature judged by you is reduced to 0 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> and you use <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>, if the new target has P &lt; STRONG, they are <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> of you (save ends). If the target is already <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> of you, they instead take holy damage equal to twice your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">

<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic ability</a> from the following options, each of which costs 7 wrath to use.</p>

<p class="sc-ability__flavor">The evil within your foes detonates with holy fire that burns only the guilty.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a></div></div>

</div>

</div>

<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Edict of Perfect Order</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 3</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">7 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">Within the area of your divine presence, your enemies will regret using their fell abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Each enemy in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">

<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Until the end of the encounter or until you are <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/dying/">dying</a>, whenever a target uses an ability that costs Malice (see *Draw Steel: Monsters*), they take holy damage equal to three times your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. A target judged by you takes an extra 2d6 holy damage.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Edict of Purifying Pacifism</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 3</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">7 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You shed a righteous energy that punishes enemies who would harm you or your allies.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Each enemy in the area</div></div>

<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>

A target judged by you takes an extra 2d6 holy damage.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Edict of Stillness</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 3</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">7 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">The holy <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a> you project makes it painful for evil-doers to leave your reach.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Each enemy in the area</div></div>
</div>

A target judged by you who moves willingly takes an extra 2d6 holy damage.</p></div>

#### 4th-Level Domain Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-4/4th-level-domain-feature" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">

<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>

<p>You gain a domain feature from your domain, as shown on the 4th-Level <a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">Censor</a> Domain Features table.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">4th-Level Censor Domain Features Table</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<table><thead><tr><th>Domain</th><th>Feature</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Creation</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/improved-hands-of-the-maker/">Improved Hands of the Maker</a></td></tr><tr><td>Death</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/seance/">Seance</a></td></tr><tr><td>Fate</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/oracular-warning/">Oracular Warning</a></td></tr><tr><td>Knowledge</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/rule/world/saint/">Saint</a>&#39;s Epiphany</td></tr><tr><td>Life</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/blessing-of-life/">Blessing of Life</a></td></tr><tr><td>Love</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/invocation-of-the-heart/">Invocation of the Heart</a></td></tr><tr><td>Nature</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/wode-road/">Wode Road</a></td></tr><tr><td>Protection</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/impervious-touch/">Impervious Touch</a></td></tr><tr><td>Storm</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/windwalk/">Windwalk</a></td></tr><tr><td>Sun</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/light-of-revelation/">Light of Revelation</a></td></tr><tr><td>Trickery</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-4/blessing-of-secrets/">Blessing of Secrets</a></td></tr><tr><td>War</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/improved-sanctified-weapon/">Improved Sanctified Weapon</a></td></tr></tbody></table>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of Life</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Life</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your divine presence causes those you deem worthy to recover quickly from a fight. Whenever an ally within <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/distance/">distance</a> of your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/my-life-for-yours/">My Life for Yours</a> ability regains <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a>, they regain additional <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of Secrets</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Trickery</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of Secrets</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Trickery</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You project an illusory <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a> that makes you and allies harder to notice.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self and each ally in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Each creature in the area has a double <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> made to <a href="../../../Browse/skill/intrigue/hide/">hide</a> or <a href="../../../Browse/skill/intrigue/sneak/">sneak</a>. The <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a> lasts until you end it (no action required) or until a target harms or deals damage to a creature or object.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Impervious Touch</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Protection</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>As a maneuver, you can touch an object with a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/size/">size</a> equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score or smaller and place a protective spell on it. The object has immunity all to untyped damage. You can maintain this spell on a number of objects equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score, and you can end the spell on any object at any time (no action required).</p>
<p>Additionally, you can place this spell on a building or vehicle (or a similar structure with the Director&#39;s approval) that is of a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/size/">size</a> larger than your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. You can place the spell on only one such target at a time, and you can maintain the spell on a larger target and a number of objects equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score simultaneously.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Improved Hands of the Maker</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Creation</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>When you use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/hands-of-the-maker/">Hands of the Maker</a> ability, you can create a mundane object that is <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/size/">size</a> 2 or smaller.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Improved Sanctified Weapon</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · War</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>The weapon improved by your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/sanctified-weapon/">Sanctified Weapon</a> feature grants a +3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage/">rolled damage</a> instead of +1.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Invocation of the Heart</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Love</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>As a main action, you forge a bond of love and friendship with one willing creature you touch. While this bond is active, you can telepathically speak with the creature over any <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/distance/">distance</a>, including across different worlds. Additionally, while this bond is active, you can attempt to assist the creature with any <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> they make regardless of their proximity to you. You can maintain only one bond at a time, and you can end a bond at any time (no action required).</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Light of Revelation</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Sun</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>As a maneuver, you make your body shine brightly, illuminating your space and each square within 5 squares until you dismiss the light (no action required). This light shines through any darkness. Hidden creatures in the area are automatically revealed, and creatures in the light, including you, can&#39;t hide. While this feature is active, you gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> made to notice hidden objects and entrances and to detect <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural/">supernatural</a> illusions.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Oracular Warning</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Fate</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Each time you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can share the vague dreams of the future granted to you by the gods with allies who finished the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> with you. These premonitions help you and your allies stay alive, granting each of you <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina/">temporary Stamina</a> equal to 10 + your level that lasts until you finish another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Seance</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Death</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You can commune with a network of spirits. As a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> activity, you speak the name of a creature who died and isn&#39;t undead. If the creature&#39;s spirit is free and willing to speak with you, they appear and you can have a conversation with them. During this time, the creature responds to you as they would have in life. If the creature isn&#39;t free or willing to appear, you can speak another name or choose another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> activity.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Saint&#39;s Epiphany</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Knowledge</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>At the start of a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can inspire yourself or another creature taking the same <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> with divine knowledge. If the target makes a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/downtime/project-roll/">project roll</a> during this <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, they can add 1d10 plus your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score to the roll.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Windwalk</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Storm</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>While you have 5 or more <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a>, you can <a href="../../../Browse/movement/fly/">fly</a>. If you can already <a href="../../../Browse/movement/fly/">fly</a>, you have a +2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a> while <a href="../../../Browse/movement/fly/">flying</a> instead.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Wode Road</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Nature</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 4</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>As a main action, you touch a living tree and make it part of a divine transportation network. You can maintain a number of trees in your network equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. Whenever you touch any tree in your network, you can use a main action to <a href="../../../Browse/movement/teleport/">teleport</a> yourself and any willing creatures within 10 squares of you to a tree in your network on the same world. If a tree in your network dies, it is no longer part of the network. You can remove a tree from your network no matter your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/distance/">distance</a> from it, including across different worlds (no action required).</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

### 5th-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 5th-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### 5th-Level Order Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-5/5th-level-order-feature" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait" data-sub="4">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">5th-Level Order Feature</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> grants you a feature, as shown on the 5th-Level Order Features table.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">5th-Level Order Features Table</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<table><thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Feature</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Exorcist</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-5/evil-revealed/">Evil Revealed</a></td></tr><tr><td>Oracle</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-5/prophecy/">Prophecy</a></td></tr><tr><td>Paragon</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-5/stand-fast/">Stand Fast</a>!</td></tr></tbody></table>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Evil Revealed</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your order has taught you methods to discern the disguises of both mortals and monsters. You automatically see through disguises and illusions created by creatures of your level or lower, and you gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> made to see through the disguises and illusions of more powerful creatures. Whenever you see through a creature&#39;s disguise or illusion, you can use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> ability against them as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Prophecy</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You can better sift through the constant fragmentary visions from your deity and act to make them manifest. Each time you earn 1 or more <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a>, you can make a number of 2d10 rolls equal to the number of <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a> you earned. Record each roll in order. Then whenever you or a creature within 10 squares makes a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll/">power roll</a>, you can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to replace the total on the dice with your first recorded roll.</p>
<p>You discard each roll as it is used, and each time you earn <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a>, you add new rolls to the bottom of the list. Any unused rolls are discarded when you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Stand Fast!</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your divine spark grows in power, allowing you and your allies to focus and endure. At the start of each of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a>, you can spend 1d6 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> to end one effect on you that is ended by a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throw</a> or that ends at the end of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>. Any ally who starts their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a> within 5 squares of you can also spend <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> to gain this benefit.</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### 9-Wrath Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-5/9-wrath-ability" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest" data-action="trait" data-sub="4">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">9-Wrath Ability</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic ability</a> from the following options, each of which costs 9 wrath to use.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main" data-conditions="prone">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Gods Grant Thee Strength</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You channel divine force for movement that cannot be stopped.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self or one ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target ends any <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/condition/">condition</a> or effect on them that is ended by a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throw</a> or that ends at the end of their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>, or a <a href="../../../Browse/condition/prone/">prone target</a> can stand up. The target then gains 2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surges</a>, can <a href="../../../Browse/movement/shifting/">shift</a> up to their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a> while ignoring <a href="../../../Browse/movement/difficult-terrain/">difficult terrain</a>, and can use a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability/">signature ability</a> as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver" data-conditions="prone">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Orison of Victory</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You channel your god&#39;s will to overcome hardship and inflict pain.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/burst/">burst</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self and each ally in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">Each target gains 1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surge</a>.</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">Each target gains 2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surges</a>.</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">Each target gains 3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surges</a>.</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>A target can end one effect on them that is ended by a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throw</a> or that ends at the end of their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>, or a <a href="../../../Browse/condition/prone/">prone target</a> can stand up.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Righteous Judgment</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You amplify the power of your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">judgment</a>.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Weapon</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a> 1</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">10 + M damage</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">14 + M damage</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">20 + M damage</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Until the end of the encounter, whenever any ally deals damage to a target judged by you, that ally gains 1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surge</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Shield of the Righteous</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 5</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You strike a foe and create a fleet of divine shields that protect your allies.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Weapon</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a> 1</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">10 + M damage; you and each ally <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> to you gain 10 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina/">temporary Stamina</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">14 + M damage; you and each ally <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> to you gain 15 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina/">temporary Stamina</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">20 + M damage; you and each ally <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> to you gain 20 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina/">temporary Stamina</a></span></div>

</article>
</div>

### 6th-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 6th-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### Implement of Wrath {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-6/implement-of-wrath" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Implement of Wrath</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Each time you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can choose one hero&#39;s weapon, including your own, to channel <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural/">supernatural</a> power as an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/treasure/implement/">implement</a> of your god&#39;s wrath. The weapon becomes magic and gains the following benefits until your next <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>:</p>
<ul><li>Strikes with the weapon deal extra holy damage equal to the wielder&#39;s highest <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic/">characteristic</a> score.</li><li>Any creature struck by the weapon who has holy weakness and has P &lt; STRONG is <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> and <a href="../../../Browse/condition/weakened/">weakened</a> (save ends).</li><li>Any minion targeted by a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> using the weapon dies. That minion&#39;s <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> maximum is removed from the minion <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> pool before any damage is applied to the rest of the squad.</li><li>The weapon&#39;s wielder can&#39;t be made <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a>.</li></ul>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-6/perk" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Perk</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You gain one interpersonal, lore, or <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural/">supernatural</a> perk of your choice.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### 6th-Level Order Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-6/6th-level-order-ability" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead sc-trait--section" data-action="trait" data-sub="3">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">6th-Level Order Ability</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> grants your choice of one of two <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic abilities</a>.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">6th-Level Exorcist Abilities</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one of the following abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Begone!</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You terrify your enemies into retreating, creating chaos in their ranks.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/burst/">burst</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Each enemy in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">4 psychic damage; <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">slide</a> 3</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">6 psychic damage; <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">slide</a> 5</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">8 psychic damage; <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">slide</a> 7</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="triggered">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">)</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Pain of Your Own Making</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Free Triggered Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You reverse the effects from an evildoer.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self or one ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Trigger</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target gains a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/condition/">condition</a> or effect that is ended by a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throw</a> or that ends at the end of their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The effect ends on the target and is applied to the creature who imposed the effect on them. That creature also takes damage equal to three times your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">6th-Level Oracle Abilities</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
