<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver" data-conditions="dazed">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Burden of Evil</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You reveal a vision of your enemies&#39; fate that causes them to scramble as it staggers them.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Three enemies</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res"><a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">Slide</a> 3; I &lt; WEAK, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/dazed/">dazed</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res"><a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">Slide</a> 5; I &lt; AVERAGE, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/dazed/">dazed</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res"><a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">Slide</a> 7; I &lt; STRONG, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/dazed/">dazed</a> (save ends)</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Edict of Peace</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You anticipate your foes&#39; moves and deny them.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v">3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/aura/">aura</a></div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Each enemy in the area</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Until the end of the encounter or until you are <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/dying/">dying</a>, whenever any target takes a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> or a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>, that action is negated and the target takes holy damage equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>

<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">6th-Level Paragon Abilities</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one of the following abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Congregation</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>

</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a></span></div>

<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">8 + M damage; as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>, one ally within 10 squares of the target can use a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability/">signature ability</a> against the target</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">12 + M damage; as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>, one ally within 10 squares of the target can use a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability/">signature ability</a> that gains an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> against the target</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">16 + M damage; as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a>, two allies within 10 squares of the target can each use a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/signature-ability/">signature ability</a> that gains an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> against the target</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Each ally can <a href="../../../Browse/movement/shifting/">shift</a> up to 2 squares and gains 2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surges</a> before making the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="triggered">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">)</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Intercede</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 6</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Free Triggered Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You take your ally&#39;s place.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Trigger</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>A creature makes a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> against the target.</p></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target is unaffected by the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a> and you become the target instead, even if you aren&#39;t a valid target for it. You take half the damage from the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strike</a>, and the target gains 3 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/surge/">surges</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

### 7th-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 7th-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-7/characteristic-increase" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Characteristic Increase</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Each of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic/">characteristic</a> scores increases by 1, to a maximum of 4.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### 7th-Level Domain Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-7/7th-level-domain-feature" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait" data-sub="13">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">7th-Level Domain Feature</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You gain a domain feature from your domain, as shown on the 7th-Level <a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">Censor</a> Domain Features table.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">7th-Level Censor Domain Features Table</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<table><thead><tr><th>Domain</th><th>Feature</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Creation</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/divine-quartermaster/">Divine Quartermaster</a></td></tr><tr><td>Death</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/word-of-death-deferred/">Word of Death Deferred</a></td></tr><tr><td>Fate</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/word-of-fate-denied/">Word of Fate Denied</a></td></tr><tr><td>Knowledge</td><td>Gods&#39; Library</td></tr><tr><td>Life</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/font-of-grace/">Font of Grace</a></td></tr><tr><td>Love</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/covenant-of-the-heart/">Covenant of the Heart</a></td></tr><tr><td>Nature</td><td>Nature&#39;s Bounty</td></tr><tr><td>Protection</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/blessing-of-iron/">Blessing of Iron</a></td></tr><tr><td>Storm</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/ride-the-lightning/">Ride the Lightning</a></td></tr><tr><td>Sun</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/light-of-the-burning-sun/">Light of the Burning Sun</a></td></tr><tr><td>Trickery</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-7/trinity-of-trickery/">Trinity of Trickery</a></td></tr><tr><td>War</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-7/your-triumphs-are-remembered/">Your Triumphs Are Remembered</a></td></tr></tbody></table>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing of Iron</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Protection</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>The gods send divine favor to you and your allies. While you are not <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/dying/">dying</a>, enemies take a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bane/">bane</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">strikes</a> against you or any ally within 3 squares of you.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Covenant of the Heart</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Love</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You can maintain bonds with up to three willing creatures using your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/invocation-of-the-heart/">Invocation of the Heart</a> feature. Additionally, you have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Guided to Your Side</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Love</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You concentrate on a friend and <a href="../../../Browse/movement/teleport/">teleport</a> to them.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self and each ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>Each target is <a href="../../../Browse/movement/teleport/">teleport</a>ed to unoccupied spaces within 5 squares of a willing creature who you are bonded to with your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/invocation-of-the-heart/">Invocation of the Heart</a> feature. You don&#39;t need <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect/">line of effect</a> to the bonded creature but you must be on the same world.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Divine Quartermaster</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Creation</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Each time you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can choose a treasure with a project goal equal to 50 times your level or less. You gain a divine version of this treasure that lasts until you finish another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a> or it is consumed.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Font of Grace</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Life</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Each time you use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/my-life-for-yours/">My Life for Yours</a> ability, you gain 1 wrath that can be spent only on that ability during the same <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>. If you don&#39;t use this wrath, it is lost. Additionally, the target of <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/my-life-for-yours/">My Life for Yours</a> gains 10 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina/">temporary Stamina</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Gods&#39; Library</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Knowledge</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You can gain access to information you need through prayer, so that you no longer require research materials for crafting and <a href="../../../Browse/rule/downtime/research-project/">research projects</a> (see Chapter 12: <a href="../downtime-projects/">Downtime Projects</a>). Additionally, you add your level to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/downtime/project-roll/">project rolls</a> you make for crafting and <a href="../../../Browse/rule/downtime/research-project/">research projects</a>. You also have any skills in the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/lore/">lore skill group</a> you don&#39;t already have, and you gain a number of skills from any other skill groups equal to the number of skills you had in the <a href="../../../Browse/skill/lore/">lore skill group</a> before you gained this feature.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Light of the Burning Sun</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Sun</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Sun infuses your body. Whenever you use an ability to deal <a href="../../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage/">rolled damage</a> to another creature, that ability deals an extra 5 fire damage, or an extra 15 fire damage if the creature is undead. Additionally, you have fire immunity equal to your level, which is added to any other fire immunity you have.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Nature&#39;s Bounty</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Nature</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>When you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can prepare a magic meal using local flora for any companions who rested with you. Choose two of the following benefits for creatures who consume the meal:</p>
<ul><li>Each creature gains immunity to acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic damage equal to your level. You can choose this benefit twice, choosing a different <a href="../../../Browse/rule/damage/damage-immunity/">damage immunity</a> each time.</li><li>Each creature gains 20 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/temporary-stamina/">temporary Stamina</a>.</li><li>Each creature gains a +1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a>.</li><li>Each creature gains a +1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throws</a>.</li><li>Each creature gains an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">tests</a> made to influence other creatures.</li></ul>
<p>Each benefit lasts until the creature who gains it finishes another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Ride the Lightning</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Storm</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Lightning and thunder infuse your body. Whenever you use an ability to deal <a href="../../../Browse/rule/damage/rolled-damage/">rolled damage</a> to another creature, the ability deals extra lightning damage equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. Additionally, if you use an ability that force moves a creature, the <a href="../../../Browse/movement/forced-movement/">forced movement</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/distance/">distance</a> gains a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score. While you are under the effect of your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/windwalk/">Windwalk</a> feature, lightning enhances your locomotion to grant you a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a> equal to your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a> score. If <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-4/windwalk/">Windwalk</a> already grants you a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a>, this <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> adds to that.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Trinity of Trickery</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Trickery</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>You have the following ability.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Trinity of Trickery</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Trickery</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">9 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">Hey! I&#39;m over here. No, here, numbskull.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">Self or one ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>You create two illusory duplicates of the target, which appear anywhere within <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/distance/">distance</a>. These duplicates last until the end of the encounter. On each of their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a>, the target can move each duplicate up to their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/speed/">speed</a>. If the target is targeted by an ability, they can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to switch places with a duplicate within their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/line-of-effect/">line of effect</a>, making the duplicate the target of the ability instead. When either duplicate takes damage, it is destroyed.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Word of Death Deferred</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Death</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You can stop death from taking your allies. When an ally within <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/distance/">distance</a> of your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/my-life-for-yours/">My Life for Yours</a> ability dies and you are not <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/dying/">dying</a>, you can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to instead have that ally fall unconscious until they regain <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a>.</p>
<p>Additionally, your abilities deal an extra 5 damage to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/winded/">winded</a> creatures.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Word of Fate Denied</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Fate</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>When an ally within 10 squares takes damage that would leave them <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/dying/">dying</a>, you can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to make yourself or another willing creature within 10 squares of you the target of the triggering damage instead. The creature you choose takes the damage and suffers any effects associated with it, and that damage can&#39;t be reduced in any way.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Your Triumphs Are Remembered</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · War</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>The gods allow you and your companions to bask in the glory of past successes. Whenever you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you and any other heroes who rested with you regain 1 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victory</a> after your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victories</a> are converted to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/experience/">XP</a>. This <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/victories/">Victory</a> isn&#39;t converted into <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/experience/">XP</a> at the end of a subsequent <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Focused Wrath {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-7/focused-wrath" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Focused Wrath</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 7</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>When you gain wrath at the start of each of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a> during combat, you gain 3 wrath instead of 2.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-7/skill" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">

#### 8th-Level Order Feature {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-8/8th-level-order-feature" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait" data-sub="4">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">8th-Level Order Feature</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 8</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> grants you a feature, as shown on the 8th-Level Order Features table.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">8th-Level Order Features Table</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<table><thead><tr><th>Order</th><th>Feature</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Exorcist</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-8/demonologist/">Demonologist</a></td></tr><tr><td>Oracle</td><td><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-8/their-past-revealed/">Their Past Revealed</a></td></tr><tr><td>Paragon</td><td>Vow</td></tr></tbody></table>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Demonologist</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 8</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>The most esoteric secrets of your order teach you that to defeat your enemy, you must understand them. You treat your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/renown/">Renown</a> as 2 higher than usual when dealing with demons, <a href="../../../Browse/ancestry/devil/">devils</a>, and other agents of chaos. If you successfully complete a negotiation with one of these creatures, you gain an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll/">power rolls</a> made against them and can use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> ability against them as a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> before an encounter begins.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Their Past Revealed</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 8</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your constant fragmentary visions become clearer, and can be honed to understand the past of creatures you interact with. While speaking with any creature, you can make a medium <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> <a href="../../../Browse/rule/test/test/">test</a> to see visions from their past. On a success, you see a clear view of any subject related to the creature&#39;s past that you wish to understand. On a success with a consequence, you see two visions, one false and one true. On a failure, you lose 2d6 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a>.</p>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Vow</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 8</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your words take on the power of your deity, with all the authority that entails. If you convince a creature to take an oath, they can&#39;t break it for 7 days. If you take an oath, you can&#39;t break it for 7 days.</p>
</div>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</address>

<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic ability</a> from the following options, each of which costs 11 wrath to use.</p>

</div>

<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">18 + M damage; I &lt; STRONG, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/weakened/">weakened</a> (save ends)</span></div>
</div>

<div class="sc-ability__section">

### 9th-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 9th-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### Improved Implement of Wrath {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-9/improved-implement-of-wrath" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Improved Implement of Wrath</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 9</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>The weapon you target with your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-6/implement-of-wrath/">Implement of Wrath</a> feature gains the following additional benefits:</p>
<ul><li>The weapon&#39;s wielder and each ally <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> to them gain a +2 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/bonuses-and-penalties/">bonus</a> to <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throws</a>.</li><li>At the end of each of the weapon wielder&#39;s <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a>, each ally <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/adjacent/">adjacent</a> to the wielder makes a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throw</a> against each effect on them that is ended by a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throw</a>.</li><li>The weapon&#39;s wielder has corruption immunity 10.</li></ul>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### 9th-Level Order Ability {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-9/9th-level-order-ability" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead sc-trait--section" data-action="trait" data-sub="3">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">9th-Level Order Ability</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 9</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-1/censor-order/">censor order</a> grants your choice of one of two <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/heroic-ability/">heroic abilities</a>.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">9th-Level Exorcist Abilities</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one of the following abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Banish</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 9</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">11 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You sever the target&#39;s tenuous connection to the world.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/melee/">Melee</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Weapon</span></div>

<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One creature</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">5 + M damage; P &lt; WEAK, the target is banished (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">8 + M damage; P &lt; AVERAGE, the target is banished (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">11 + M damage; P &lt; STRONG, the target is banished (save ends)</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>This ability gains an <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> against demons, <a href="../../../Browse/ancestry/devil/">devils</a>, undead, and creatures not native to your current world. If you know the target&#39;s true name, this ability has a double <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a>. While banished, the target is sent to another manifold in the timescape and removed from the encounter map. A banished target can do nothing but make <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/saving-throw/">saving throws</a>, and takes 10 holy damage each time they do so. If the target is reduced to 0 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a> while banished, they are lost to the timescape.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main" data-conditions="frightened">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">l</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Terror Manifest</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Exorcist</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 9</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">11 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Main Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">&#34;I know what you fear.&#34;</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/strike/">Strike</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">

</div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr">
<div class="sc-ability__pr-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="pre">Power Roll +</span><span class="chars"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__pr-rows">
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="low"><span class="badge">!</span><span class="res">7 + P psychic damage; P &lt; WEAK, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="mid"><span class="badge">@</span><span class="res">10 + P psychic damage; P &lt; AVERAGE, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> (save ends)</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__tier" data-tier="high"><span class="badge">#</span><span class="res">13 + P psychic damage; P &lt; STRONG, <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> (save ends)</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>While <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> this way, if a target who is a leader or solo creature is <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/winded/">winded</a>, they take an extra 25 psychic damage. If a target <a href="../../../Browse/condition/frightened/">frightened</a> this way is not a leader or solo creature and is <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/winded/">winded</a>, they are reduced to 0 <a href="../../../Browse/rule/health/stamina/">Stamina</a>.</p></div>
</div>

<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">9th-Level Oracle Abilities</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p class="sc-trait__leadin"><span class="sc-trait__dia"></span>Choose one of the following abilities.</p>
<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="triggered">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">)</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Blessing and a Curse</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 9</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">11 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Triggered Action</div></div></header>

<div class="sc-ability__rail">

</div>

<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target obtains a tier 1 or tier 3 outcome on their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll/">power roll</a> (your choice). You can then choose another target within <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/distance/">distance</a>, who obtains the opposite outcome on their next <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll/">power roll</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="triggered">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">)</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Fulfill Your Destiny</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Oracle</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 9</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">11 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Triggered Action</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You have looked at various futures, and only this one works.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span><span class="sc-ability__chip"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a></span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__rail">
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Distance</div><div class="v"><a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/ranged/">Ranged</a> 10</div></div>
<div class="sc-ability__cell"><div class="l">Targets</div><div class="v">One ally</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">

</div>
<div class="sc-ability__section">
<div class="sc-ability__section-head"><span class="sc-ability__dia"></span><span class="tag">Effect</span></div>
<div class="sc-ability__section-body"><p>The target takes their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a> after the triggering hero, and immediately removes all <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/condition/">conditions</a> and negative effects on themself. During their <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turn</a>, the target has a double <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll/">power rolls</a>.</p></div>
</div>
</article>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="sc-trait" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">9th-Level Paragon Abilities</h3></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"></div></header>

<div class="sc-trait__nest">
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="main">

</div>

</div>
</article>
<article class="sc-ability sc-fil" data-action="maneuver">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-ability__crest"><span class="sc-ability__glyph">f</span></span><div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Ability</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Edict of Unyielding Resolve</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor · Paragon</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 9</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-primary sc-head__slot--mini">11 Wrath</div><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-deck sc-head__slot--chip">Maneuver</div></div></header>
<p class="sc-ability__flavor">You and your allies are clad in shimmering armor.</p>
<div class="sc-ability__kw"><span class="sc-ability__chip">Area</span><span class="sc-ability__chip">Magic</span></div>

### 10th-Level Features {data-search-exclude=""}

As a 10th-level [censor](../../Browse/class/censor.md), you gain the following features.

#### Characteristic Increase {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-10/characteristic-increase" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Characteristic Increase</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 10</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>Your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/might/">Might</a> and <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> scores each increase to 5.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Perk {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-10/perk" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Perk</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 10</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You gain one crafting, lore, or <a href="../../../Browse/rule/general/supernatural/">supernatural</a> perk of your choice.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Skill {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-10/skill" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Skill</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 10</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You gain one skill of your choice.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Templar {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-10/templar" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Templar</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 10</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You are the ultimate representation of your god&#39;s justice in the timescape. Whenever you use your <a href="../../../Browse/feature/ability/censor/level-1/judgment/">Judgment</a> ability, you can use a free <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/triggered-action/">triggered action</a> to use a <a href="../../../Browse/class/conduit/">conduit</a> domain effect (see <a href="../../../Browse/feature/conduit/level-1/domain-piety-and-effects/">Domain Piety and Effects</a> in the <a href="../../../Browse/class/conduit/">Conduit</a> section) associated with your chosen domain, or a domain you access with <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-10/virtue/">virtue</a> (see below). If the effect calls for the use of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/intuition/">Intuition</a> score, you use your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/character/presence/">Presence</a> score instead. If the effect uses your <a href="../../../Browse/class/conduit/">conduit</a> level, use your <a href="../../../Browse/class/censor/">censor</a> level instead.</p>
<p>Additionally, whenever you take a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you can open a portal to rest in the presence of your deity and bring along any allies. When you do, you can ask your deity three questions, which the Director must answer honestly if your deity knows the answers (though they might answer cryptically or incompletely). When you finish your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you and your allies can appear at any location in the timescape where someone worships your deity.</p>
<p>While you rest in their presence, your god might also give you priority targets to enact justice upon. You and your allies each have a double <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/edge/">edge</a> on <a href="../../../Browse/rule/dice/power-roll/">power rolls</a> made against such targets. If you attempt to open a portal to your deity again before you have defeated your priority targets, you suffer your god&#39;s wrath, as determined by the Director.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Virtue {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-10/virtue" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Virtue</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 10</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>You have an epic resource called <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-10/virtue/">virtue</a>. Each time you finish a <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>, you gain <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-10/virtue/">virtue</a> equal to the <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/experience/">XP</a> you gain. You can spend <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-10/virtue/">virtue</a> on your abilities as if it were wrath.</p>
<p>Additionally, you can spend 3 <a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-10/virtue/">virtue</a> to access one of your deity&#39;s domains that you usually don&#39;t have access to. When you do, you can use that domain&#39;s features until you finish another <a href="../../../Browse/rule/resource/respite/">respite</a>.</p>
<p><a href="../../../Browse/feature/censor/level-10/virtue/">Virtue</a> remains until you spend it.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

#### Wrath of the Gods {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.censor.level-10/wrath-of-the-gods" data-search-exclude=""}

<address class="sc-embed" data-search-exclude="">
<section class="sc-trait sc-trait--crest sc-trait--lead" data-action="trait">
<header class="sc-head"><div class="sc-head__stack"><span class="sc-crest sc-trait__crest"><span class="sc-trait__glyph">*</span></span>
<div class="sc-head__col sc-head__col--left"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-eyebrow sc-head__slot--line">Feature</div><h3 class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-primary sc-head__slot--line">Wrath of the Gods</h3><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__left-deck sc-head__slot--line">Censor</div></div></div><div class="sc-head__rail sc-head__col--right"><div class="sc-head__slot sc-head__right-eyebrow sc-head__slot--chip">Level 10</div></div></header>
<div class="sc-trait__body">
<p>When you gain wrath at the start of each of your <a href="../../../Browse/rule/combat/turn/">turns</a> during combat, you gain 4 wrath instead of 3.</p>
</div>
</section>
</address>

## Conduit {data-scc="mcdm.heroes.v1/class/conduit" data-search-exclude=""}

The power of the gods flows through you! As a vessel for [divine power](../../Browse/feature/conduit/level-10/divine-power.md), you don't just keep your allies in the fight. You make those allies more effective, even as you rain divine energy down upon your foes. Though the deity or [saint](../../Browse/rule/world/saint.md) you serve might have other faithful and clergy, you are special among worshippers, receiving your abilities from the highest source.

**As a [conduit](../../Browse/class/conduit.md), you heal and buff your allies, and debuff your foes while smiting them with divine magic. The spark of divinity within you shines, filling your enemies with awe and making you more worldly and aware.**

> "The gods judge our actions, and our inaction."
>
> **Dazar**

### Basics {data-search-exclude=""}

**Starting [Characteristics](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md):** You start with an [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) of 2, and can choose one of the following arrays for your other [characteristic](../../Browse/rule/character/characteristic.md) scores:

- 2, 2, −1, −1
- 2, 1, 1, −1
- 2, 1, 0, 0
- 1, 1, 1, 0

**Weak [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) - 2

**Average [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md) - 1

**Strong [Potency](../../Browse/rule/character/potency.md):** [Intuition](../../Browse/rule/character/intuition.md)

**Starting [Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) at 1st Level:** 18

**[Stamina](../../Browse/rule/health/stamina.md) Gained at 2nd and Higher Levels:** 6

**[Recoveries](../../Browse/rule/health/recoveries.md):** 8

**Skills:** Choose any two skills from the [interpersonal](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/index.md) or [lore](../../Browse/skill/lore/index.md) skill groups (see Skills in Chapter 9: [Tests](tests.md)). (*Quick Build:* [Read Person](../../Browse/skill/interpersonal/read-person.md), Religion.)
